## Standard: **Helicopter**

Standard

AH1

[Create your badge here](https://sws.flaffipony.rocks?s=AH1%20%20)

### Rules of this standard

- [Parent standard rules apply](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Air)
- Stable landing gear (at least 3 touchpoints so the the helicopter is not flipping upside down when landing)

### Feature rules

- see [global feature rules](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Standards/Features)

### Size rules

- None - This standard does not have any size dependent rules
